title: Sort bottles safely in a crowded vertical rack
instruction: Sort all six bottles between the stacked shelves: red below, blue above. The gray staging pedestal is available. Keep every bottle upright and prevent falls, including neighboring bottles. Finish with both grippers open and withdrawn, with every bottle stable for two seconds.
context: Storage and return logistics often require correcting a mixed arrangement while preserving neighboring containers. Unlike removing one selected bottle to an empty tray, this task requires moving misplaced bottles between two constrained shelf levels and finishing with the whole rack correctly classified and stable.
setup: YAM station; wood table 1100x1300x60 mm. Wood rack: 2 shelves and roof 130x170x12 mm, back 12x194x320, 2 sides 130x12x370; gray wood stage 80x80x160. Six plastic bottles: height 100 mm, diameter 36 mm, mass 80 g. Shelf tops z=797.5/957.5 mm; bottles x=294, y=0,+/-60 mm. Lower row red/blue/red; upper blue/red/blue. Front margin 6 mm, neighbor gap 24 mm. Full inventory, materials, poses and station parts: scene_inventory.json and README.md.
scoring: Any bottle tilt>20deg, downward speed>0.35m/s, bottom z<0.7915m, top z>1.1775m, center x outside [0.07,0.44] or y outside [-0.15,0.27] m, or invalid pose: permanent 0. Sorted: whole bounding box on matching shelf, edge margin>=3mm, bottom within 4mm, tilt<=5deg. Credit needs 2s with all tilts<=5deg, center drift<=3mm from window start, jaws>=75% open, both TCPs>=85mm from every center. Score=max(0,sorted-4)/2: 0,0.5,1; initial 0. See PHYSICAL_SCORING.md.
reset_notes: Restore the six listed upright bottle poses, zero velocities, arms to READY, and a fresh safety latch. Fixtures remain fixed. Use seed 0 and zero pose jitter.
fidelity: PhysX rigid contact/gravity at 240 Hz; robot control and final stability samples at 20 Hz. Compound bottle colliders, fixed wood rack and real contact constraints; no snapping or attachments. Physical trials use colored plastic bottles. Glass fracture and material damage are outside scope. Force is telemetry only; vertical-axis spin is irrelevant. Pose-based safety is latched, with a two-second position-drift/release window. Calibrated-video measurement limits: PHYSICAL_SCORING.md.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0; scripted demo: 1.0. Both recorded under the finalized observable scorer.
